newsitem.title: UK: T-bonds nervous in London before inflation data.
newsitem.headline: T-bonds nervous in London before inflation data.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries remained mostly stagnant in London on Tuesday as nerves ahead of key inflation data due later pervaded the market.

A flurry of action was sparked in the 10-year area after Tokyo Electric (Tepco) issued a $1.0 billion 10-year Eurobond, with traders saying the news sparked some buying in the 10-year area of the Treasury curve.

"The issue initially caused some buying in the 10-year sector because the deal was swapped," said one T-bond trader as a U.S. bank in London. But he added that he expected the pricing of the Tepco deal to exert selling pressure on Treasuries.
The Tepco deal was priced at around 1006 GMT at 99.758 with a spread of 32 basis points.
By 1011 GMT, the 30-year benchmark long bond was trading at 95-20 for a yield of 6.84 percent. The bond ended Tokyo's session at 95-16 and New York's session at 95-17.
The March T-bond future was 3/32 higher on the day at 110-16 in automated trade.
Players said the market had settled into a wait-and-see mode.
"It is a pretty quiet market," said another London-based trader. "Most people are waiting for this afternoon's numbers."

According to a poll conducted by Reuters, U.S. December consumer prices are expected to show a rise of 0.3 pct compared with 0.3 percent previously, while retail sales were seen up 0.5 percent versus a 0.4 percent drop in November.
Both numbers are slated for release at 1330 GMT, with December real earnings data due at 1500 GMT.
But caution was the order of the day with sentiment trapped in negative ground after last Friday's strong U.S. jobs report.
"Even if we get a friendly number this afternoon, the market is likely to see it as a selling opportunity," said the U.S. bank's trader. "The risks are definitely more to the downside."
Some analysts said the yield on the long bond would have to test the 7.0 percent level before investors would begin to think about buying the market again.
